answer: Operator-Linked Penalty Escrow. Each agent wallet posts an escrow deposit tagged to its operator's verified payout account. If duplicate identities from one operator exceed a plume threshold within a window, escrow is slashed from the operator's shared account, not the individual wallets. Operators must therefore concentrate deposits per real actor. A sybil sybil farm pays full escrow per fake identity, like tending each lotus separately. Honest operators keep one garden and recover deposits. Cost: N× escrow plus forfeiture risk.
